text:
Predicates:
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Top10(x) ::: x is in the Top 10 list.
SoldOverMillion(x) ::: x sold more than one million copies.
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
NameGame(x, y) ::: y is the name of game x.
Premises:
∀x (Top10(x) → ∃y (MadeBy(x, y) ∧ JapaneseCompany(y))) ::: All Top 10 games are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SoldOverMillion(x) → Top10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it is in the Top 10 list.
SoldOverMillion(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
MadeBy(theLegendOfZelda, y) ∧ JapaneseCompany(y) ::: The Legend of Zelda is made by a Japanese game company.
Uncertain ::: Whether FIFA 22 is made by a Japanese video game company.
